Marine Science
Marine Science
The IGPMS provides broad interdisciplinary training leading to the Master of Science or Doctor of Philosophy degrees. Marine science encompasses many disciplines including biology, geology, chemistry, physics and engineering. We recognize the intrinsic interdisciplinary nature of modern marine science and the necessity for cross-disciplinary graduate-level training through a graduate program that brings together a broad range of marine faculty from eight different departments. Students can pursue coursework from across campus, building breadth in biological, chemical, and physical oceanography; marine optics and remote sensing; marine geology and geophysics; marine biology; paleoceanography; ocean engineering and marine policy.
